name: Refinishing Parquet Floors in Bellevue: What's Possible and What Isn't
title-tag: Refinishing Parquet Floors in Bellevue, WA: An Honest Guide
meta-description: Can Bellevue parquet floors be refinished? Usually yes — with the right multi-directional sanding. What works, what fails, and why dark stain goes checkerboard.
post-summary: December 11, 2026 · Most solid oak parquet in Bellevue's 60s–80s homes refinishes beautifully at $3.99/sq ft — but alternating grain demands multi-directional sanding, and dark stain tends to go checkerboard. What's saveable, what isn't, and how to tell before anyone bids demolition.
